data.headline: Executive Coach | Certified Independent Director | Guest Speaker | HR Professional
data.about: I help successful leaders achieve high performance without sacrificing happiness, well-being, and meaning.After decades of working closely with senior leaders, I’ve seen a recurring pattern: people who have done “everything right” professionally, yet feel a quiet sense of emptiness once the milestones are reached. The promotions, goals, and applause fade—but the question of *what actually makes us happy* remains.My work as an Executive Coach, Speaker, and Podcast Host sits at the intersection of happiness, identity, ambition, and meaning. I draw from psychology, philosophy, lived experience, and years of coaching CXOs, senior leaders, and young adults navigating inflection points in their lives and careers. The focus is not on fixing people—but on helping them rediscover clarity, alignment, and fulfillment beyond external validation.I am regularly invited to speak at:* Corporates and leadership forums* Universities and business schools* Podcasts and leadership platformsMy talks and conversations explore themes such as:* Happiness beyond achievement* Life after success* Identity, ambition, and the cost of constant pursuit* Redefining success without losing driveI also host The Happy Sapiens Podcast focused on happiness —real conversations on what fulfillment looks like in a world obsessed with performance and progress.Professionally, I bring close to 30  years of experience across global organizations including Wipro, GE, American Express, HP, Dell, and Aon. While my background is rooted in HR and leadership advisory, today it primarily informs my coaching and speaking work—adding depth, context, and real-world relevance to the conversations I lead.If you’re someone who has achieved a lot but feels there’s more to understand about happiness, meaning, and self-connection—this is the work I care deeply about.

description.text:

	Responsible for managing teams performance and development with specific accountability for associate engagement, succession planning and retention objectives.
	Accountable for ensuring client specific SLAs and KPIs are met.  
	Coach and develop senior managers and high potential performers in team. 
	Accountable for high quality delivery of HRO services to global business units through offshore teams. 
	Ensure business continuity plans are established, documented and tested periodically. 
	Participate in RFP / Deal Model discussions with clients. 
	Provide accurate and timely staffing needs for new client deals to global sales and solutions teams. 
	Represent India LT in client meetings/ prospect client visits at various levels. 
	Work with support functions for resource planning, hiring, IT and real estate related requirements for any new client implementation. 
	Make strategic decisions on India locations to put new client work in line with global strategy. 
	Accountable for developing and managing key internal / external client relationships across sphere of influence, including situations in which no relationship previously existed.
	Monitor and identify areas where requests for services are not included in the budgets and collaborate with BU and finance to adjust budgets.

	Overall responsible for on boarding of new hires at DIS Gurgaon. 
	Regularly conduct brown bags, scheduled 1x1s with employees during their first 90days tenure. 
	Proactively engage with employees at all levels to effectively manage attrition in the group. Regularly review EWS cases with all training and TQ managers. 
	Investigate all ethics and background verification issues and seek clarification /sufficient information from erring employees. 
	Conduct regular communication on HR policies and procedures on regular basis.
	Conduct Exit Interviews with all exiting employees.

	Part of the Worldwide Partner Management team of Dell International Services. 
	Overall responsible for Dell's Consumer Technical Support business outsourced to Genpact Jaipur. - Between Jaipur and Delhi, the site had team of 300+ agents, TLs, Area Managers and AVPs. 
	Deliver, through the management of the partner, on all operational, compliance and customer experience metrics. Continuously evaluate the effectiveness of the partner by ensuring a clear process exists for measuring all aspects of site performance, so that excellent results are delivered and continuous improvement becomes business as usual. 
	Ensure all new concepts/metrics introduced by Dell are thoroughly understood and delivered by Genpact. Conduct sessions with TLs and above to apprise them of the change/revision of policy, metric, concept, tool so it can be further disseminated to agents on the floor. 
	Conduct regular brown bags (skip level meetings) with agents, TLs, Managers and AVPs to gather feedback on Dell's business processes, tools, policies and channelize it to pertinent teams in Dell. Also share actions taken by Dell based on feedback collected from its partners on a quarterly basis. 
	Worked as interface between Genpact and Dell's finance teams to settle all outstanding invoice claims. Also worked as approving authority of all monthly invoices raised by Genpact.

•		Handled 2 separate tech support processes (one voice and another non voice) with a total span of 175 employees. 
	Responsible for managing entire operations for PL - All In One - ranging from hiring profiles across different levels, co-ordination with training for effective/timely training delivery, managing performance metrics on the operations floor, conducting year end appraisals, call volume forecasting, conducting regular reviews with TLs. 
	Successfully handled 3 pilot projects - One of the projects had an estimated savings of $ 12,00,000 on annualized basis.

	Lead a team of 15 CSAs who provided customer service support to Amex Corporate Cardmembers. 
	Responsibilities across various functions and focus on leading specific business-wide initiatives, supporting unit-wide communications, leading employee satisfaction initiatives, supporting Recruitment strategy and ensuring effective running of the operations. 
	Develop and execute communication strategies which ensured effective and timely transmission of business/employee information across a multi-cultured organization, including managing off sites and town halls .
	Management of all aspects of the year-end appraisal (PMP) process.

subComponents.text: Grow More Coach Model is an International Coach Certification program Accredited by ICF (International Coach Federation, USA). It is a 80-hour Level1 /142-hour Level2 program which ensures intense learning of coaching skills through its unique method of facilitation. The participants gain mastery over theory and practice by engaging in 50 to 55 practice coaching sessions. Last but not the least, being connected to the vibrant community 1100+ Grow More Coaches is a great value addition to professional and personal life. As a Grow More Coach, I am now equipped to help individuals and organisations bring positive sustainable change using multiple internationally proven tools and techniques.
